Instant Foxtail Millet Noodles

Prepared using Sprouted Foxtail Millet Flour, these instant noodles offer a convenient way to enjoy millet-based meals. The noodles are made with carefully selected ingredients and paired with a natural spice blend containing herbs and spices for authentic flavour. Quick to prepare in just a few minutes, they are suitable for everyday meals or snacks and can be enjoyed by children and adults as part of a balanced diet. 

Noodles 

  • Sprouted Foxtail Millet Flour 

  • Arrowroot Flour 

  • Guar Gum Powder

  • Keep the pack tightly sealed after opening. 
  • Protect from moisture.
